title: Echo Eyatuuka Ku Nnamulondo
intro: Ekifaananyi ekizitowa kyasemberera entebe y’obwenkanya, ng’eddoboozi lyabwe likankana si lwa kutya wabula n’essuubi. Ensonga eyo yali ya muntu ku bubwe, naye ate okugonjoola kwayo kwandizzeemu okuyita mu biseera, ne kumenyawo ennono enyigiriza. Omwoyo guno gwe gwali ani okwemulugunya kwe okwawulirwa okusukka emmunyeenye?
clues: Najja n’omutima omuzito, nga nnoonya obwenkanya mu nsonga eyansiba olulimi lwange.
Okwegayirira kwange tekwali eri omubaka yekka; kyalinnya emitala, eri Oyo awulira byonna.
Nayomba era ne nsonga, n’amaziga era n’ensonga, olw’ekitiibwa kyange.
Okubikkulirwa kwakka, nga kusirisa amakubo amakadde era nga kukkiriza obulumi bwange.
Bampita oyo eyakaayana ku baze, era erinnya lyange ne lifuuka lye limu n’essuula eyansumulula.

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
